text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap, Tamamo Cross, and... Super 
Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where the three currently 
most talked-about Umamusume were destined 
to clash—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome a year filled with 
worries, Super Creek headed out onto the 
grand stage she had finally reached...
